description: This file defines repository interfaces and their implementations for managing customers, outages, and jobs in an outage management system. It includes data access methods that interact with a MySQL database using Dapper, implementing CRUD operations and complex queries.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Implementation of ICustomerRepository for accessing customer data in the database.

classes.name: OutageRepository
classes.description: Implementation of IOutageRepository for managing outage records, including creation, retrieval, updating status, and adding updates.

classes.name: JobRepository
classes.description: Implementation of IJobRepository for managing job records, including creation, assignment, status updates, and retrieving job events.

methods.name: GetCustomerByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their user ID.

methods.name: SearchCustomersAsync
methods.description: Searches for customers matching a query within an organization.

methods.name: GetOutageAsync
methods.description: Retrieves outage details by outage ID.

methods.name: ListOutagesAsync
methods.description: Lists outages with optional status and severity filters, supporting pagination.

methods.name: CreateOutageAsync
methods.description: Creates a new outage with associated location, and logs an initial outage update.

methods.name: UpdateOutageStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing outage and logs the status change.

methods.name: AddOutageUpdateAsync
methods.description: Adds a new update entry to an outage.

methods.name: GetOutageUpdatesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves updates for a specific outage with pagination.

methods.name: GetJobAsync
methods.description: Retrieves job details by job ID.

methods.name: ListJobsAsync
methods.description: Lists jobs with optional status and outage ID filters, supporting pagination.

methods.name: CreateJobAsync
methods.description: Creates a new job and logs the initial status event.

methods.name: AssignJobAsync
methods.description: Assigns a crew and user to a job, changing its status to 'assigned' and logging the event.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of a job and logs the status change.

methods.name: GetJobStatusEventsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves status change events for a job.
